messages:
Alex (Finance): Heads up — noticed a ~45% month-over-month GPU spend jump in the hosted projects bucket. Pulling the invoice now but need a quick allocation breakdown by team/customer so we can decide whether to trigger emergency reserves.

billing-bot: Automated alert: gpu-usage > threshold for month-to-date on project: hosted-models. Spike started around 2026-02-12. See /alerts/177299 for details. :warning:

Jamie (Infra): Which projects specifically? hosted-models is broad. Can you paste the invoice lines or the top consumers from the cost API?

Alex (Finance): Quick snippet from cost report:
```
2026-02-14  host: hosted-models  service: gpu  sku: A100  cost: $28,300  tags: team=research,customer=acme
2026-02-15  host: hosted-models  service: gpu  sku: A100  cost: $19,800  tags: team=prod,customer=internal
2026-02-16  host: hosted-models  service: gpu  sku: A100  cost: $12,450  tags: team=research,customer=beta
```
Not attributing cleanly by team in some rows — some jobs missing team tags.

Sam (Research): We ran two long sweeps for embedding quantization between 02/12–02/16 (lots of long sequences). I think one of the runs used the wrong config and didn't get preempted. cc @Jamie

Jamie (Infra): If it's the non-preemptible run that will burn a lot. Run this internal query to find untagged instances:
```
cost-lookup --project hosted-models --from 2026-02-10 --to 2026-02-18 --filter "tag:team==null" --group-by job_name
```
It should show the runaway job. I can patch autoscale policy to cap GPU hours if confirmed.

Lisa (Product): We need a tight allocation for finance now — can we map untagged costs to owner teams using job_name or repo tags? Even a best-effort mapping is fine for the provisional invoice.

Jamie (Infra): Yep. Output from that query shows `dedup-embed-sweep` and `quant-sweep-2026` as top untagged consumers. I can attach owner via job -> repo -> CODEOWNERS mapping. Sending a quick CSV in a sec.

Alex (Finance): Perfect. Once you send the CSV I'll run the chargeback rules and produce a provisional invoice. If research is on the hook for >$30k extra we'll need approval from Eng Leads for reallocation.

Sam (Research): Confirmed both sweeps were ours. One used a non-preemptible template by accident (`template: gpu-large-no-preempt`). Sorry — will cover half but need a small budget transfer request from prod for the rest? How do we file it?

Alex (Finance): For intra-org transfers, file a ticket in finance-tools with subject: "Inter-team GPU transfer request" and attach the provisional invoice + justification. I'll pre-approve up to $15k; anything above goes to finance director.

Jamie (Infra): I also pushed a short-term fix: autoscale cap 24h on sweeps and added a hook to enforce `team` tag at submit-time. Longer-term we should add billing guardrails in the job submission UI.

Lisa (Product): Can someone add this to the monthly review deck? We need to call out process change and alert tuning. I'll add a slide.

Alex (Finance): CSV received, ran mapping, provisional allocation attached to the ticket. Estimated reallocation: Research $32,900, Prod $12,000, Internal platform $6,200. Filing the transfer request now. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:

billing-bot: Ticket created: FIN-4821 by Alex (Finance) — "Inter-team GPU transfer request" — https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/FIN-4821

Sam (Research): Thanks — will follow up on internal approvals and re-run sweeps with preemptible templates next time.
